cur-fossil-emu-bay.dateNote: In 1952 Reg Sprigg found fossils near the Emu Bay jetty on Kangaroo Island; Brian Daily found the richer Big Gully site in 1954. The shale is about 514 million years old (Cambrian) and keeps soft parts, even eyes.
cur-fossil-emu-bay.summary: Australia's own Burgess Shale: Cambrian sea animals, soft parts and eyes included.

cur-find-warratyi.dateNote: A rock shelter in South Australia's Flinders Ranges shows people in the dry interior about 49,000 years ago, with bone of the giant marsupial Diprotodon (Hamm et al., Nature, 2016).
